20:120:13.why: يَبْلَىٰ in وَمُلْكٍ لَّا يَبْلَىٰ (20:120) is بَلِيَ يَبْلَى 'to wear out, decay' (root بلي), not بَلَا يَبْلُو 'to test'. The corpus files it under بلو form I, which made it an example ayah and an attested present huwa form of 'to test'.

33:14:11.why: تَلَبَّثُوا in وَمَا تَلَبَّثُوا بِهَا إِلَّا يَسِيرًا (33:14) is Form V تَلَبَّثَ (doubled ب, prefix تَ), not Form I لَبِثَ. The corpus tags it VF:1, which counted تَلَبَّثُوا as a Form I past hum spelling.

79:22:3.why: يَسْعَىٰ in ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ (79:22) is a present indicative (prefix يَـ, 'then he turned away, striving'), yet the corpus tags it PERF, which counted it as a past huwa spelling and showed it as a past-tense example of سَعَى.
